question: Deal Cloud-Storage-Pro di stage proposal, tampilkan id, judul, stage, nilai, dan probabilitasnya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.probability FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'proposal' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Cloud-Storage-Pro')

question: Berapa banyak pelanggan yang tagnya hanya 'retail' (satu-satunya tag)?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.tags = ['retail']

question: Pelanggan yang tag-nya tepat sama dengan ['tech','finance'], tampilkan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.tags = ['tech','finance']

question: Tag terakhir tiap pelanggan Mid-Market, tampilkan id, nama, dan tag terakhir (hanya yang punya tag).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.tags[-1] AS tag_terakhir FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Mid-Market' AND notEmpty(c.tags)

question: Pelanggan churn di region NA yang bertag high-value.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND c.attributes['region'] = 'NA' AND has(c.tags, 'high-value')

question: list pelanggan blacklisted di industri Manufacturing
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'blacklisted' AND c.attributes['industry'] = 'Manufacturing'

question: Dari pelanggan baru bulan lalu, berapa yang bertag tech?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfMonth(today()) AND has(c.tags, 'tech')

question: Aktivitas meeting per wilayah pelanggan dalam 30 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS region, count() AS jumlah_meeting FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY region ORDER BY jumlah_meeting DESC

question: Rata-rata waktu resolusi tiket (jam) per industri pelanggan, hanya tiket resolved.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'resolved' GROUP BY industry ORDER BY rata_rata_jam DESC

question: jumlah deal per customer_id yang memuat Security-Plus, 5 teratas
sql: SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus') GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC LIMIT 5

question: Nilai deal won rata-rata per tag pelanggan.
sql: SELECT tag, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC

question: Jumlah pelanggan unik yg punya deal berjalan, per tag
sql: SELECT tag, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY tag ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Tag mana yang pelanggannya punya total omset di atas 20 juta? Tampilkan tag dan omset.
sql: SELECT tag, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tag HAVING total_omset > 20000000 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Daftar nilai unik industri pelanggan.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.attributes['industry'] AS industry FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['industry'] != '' ORDER BY industry

question: wilayah pelanggan apa saja yg ada? (distinct)
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.attributes['region'] AS region FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] != '' ORDER BY region

question: Berapa jumlah kombinasi region dan tier yang berbeda?
sql: SELECT uniqExact(c.attributes['region'], c.attributes['tier']) AS jumlah_kombinasi FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Pelanggan tier Silver atau Bronze yang bertag tech atau finance, di wilayah APAC.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] IN ('Silver','Bronze') AND hasAny(c.tags, ['tech','finance']) AND c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC'

question: Segmen mana yang rata-rata jumlah tag pelanggannya lebih dari 2? Tampilkan segmen dan rata-ratanya.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(length(c.tags)), 2) AS rata_rata_jumlah_tag FROM customers AS c FINAL GROUP BY c.segment HAVING avg(length(c.tags)) > 2

question: Berapa deal won per tier pelanggan yang memuat minimal 2 produk?
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND length(d.products_involved) >= 2 GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier

question: Tampilkan produk-produk berbeda yang muncul di deal pelanggan Enterprise (distinct produk).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT product FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY product

question: Jumlah deal yang memuat tepat dua produk per sales (id dan nama), 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE length(d.products_involved) = 2 GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC LIMIT 5

question: Berapa deal lost yang memuat Security-Plus per bulan sepanjang tahun lalu?
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus') AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: jumlah pelanggan per status utk yg bertag retail
sql: SELECT c.status, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'retail') GROUP BY c.status ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Per segmen, berapa pelanggan yang bertag manufacturing?
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'manufacturing') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: pelanggan mid-market yg punya tag tech, tampilkan
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Mid-Market' AND has(c.tags, 'tech')

question: Berapa deal yang memuat Analytics-Suite?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite')

question: Tampilkan pelanggan tier Bronze.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Bronze'

question: hitung pelanggan region NA
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'NA'

question: jml deal yg isinya cuma 1 produk di stage won
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND length(d.products_involved) = 1

question: Berapa pelanggan yang tag-nya lebih dari satu?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE length(c.tags) > 1

question: Tampilkan deal lost yang memuat CRM-Connect.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND has(d.products_involved, 'CRM-Connect')

question: pelanggan prospect bertag finance berapa?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'prospect' AND has(c.tags, 'finance')

question: Siapa saja pelanggan lead yang bertag high-value? (tampilkan id dan nama)
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'lead' AND has(c.tags, 'high-value')

question: nama dan email pelanggan bertag strategic, cukup itu aja
sql: SELECT c.name, c.email FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'strategic')

question: Pelanggan mana yang deal-nya memuat lebih dari 3 produk unik? Tampilkan id, nama, jumlah produk unik.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(product) AS jumlah_produk_unik FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_produk_unik > 3 ORDER BY jumlah_produk_unik DESC

question: Rata-rata nilai deal per produk, khusus deal yang hanya memuat 1 produk.
sql: SELECT d.products_involved[1] AS produk, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE length(d.products_involved) = 1 GROUP BY produk ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC

question: Omset per wilayah pelanggan dan per produk, 10 teratas.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS region, product, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY region, product ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 10

question: Pelanggan yang tidak punya tag tech maupun retail (tidak keduanya).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE NOT hasAny(c.tags, ['tech','retail'])

question: Jumlah pelanggan yang punya salah satu tag strategic atau high-value, per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE hasAny(c.tags, ['strategic','high-value']) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: kasih liat 15 customer dgn tag paling banyak, + jumlah tagnya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, length(c.tags) AS jumlah_tag FROM customers AS c FINAL ORDER BY jumlah_tag DESC LIMIT 15

question: Berapa deal per produk yang nilainya di atas 150000?
sql: SELECT product, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.value > 150000 GROUP BY product ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Tampilkan deal yang punya Security-Plus pada produk pertama atau kedua.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.products_involved[1] = 'Security-Plus' OR d.products_involved[2] = 'Security-Plus'

question: jumlah pelanggan per tag untuk segmen Enterprise saja, urut abjad tag
sql: SELECT tag, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL ARRAY JOIN c.tags AS tag WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY tag

question: Berapa deal won per sales (id, nama) yang memuat API-Gateway? Hanya sales dengan minimal 10 deal.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'API-Gateway') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_deal >= 10 ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Total omset deal won pelanggan per tier dan industri, 8 teratas.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, c.attributes['industry'] AS industry, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tier, industry ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 8
